capabilities.justification: `kiln verify-vectors <path>` reads the vector file named on the command line; the Source adapters read the source tree (through os.Root, never following symlinks out of it) and, for GitHub trust, the GitHub-generated event JSON at GITHUB_EVENT_PATH (size-capped).
The CLI prints its version and verification results.
The Git Source runs the `git` binary (ls-files, rev-parse, diff) with an argument vector and never through a shell.
The GitHub Host reads its identity, trust inputs and shard from the runner environment. The whole environment is forwarded to `git` only after credentials and every GIT_* variable are scrubbed.
The Local Host creates a private work directory under the OS temp dir.

justification: Kiln's key encoder is pure computation; the CLI reads a vector file and prints results; the Source and Host adapters run git, read the CI environment and walk the source tree.
